projects.title: SWIR Bio Imaging System
summary: **Goal:** Pioneering applications, where visible imaging fails.
**Key Results:** SWIR Hyperspectral Imaging System
**My Role**: Planning application, Optical design/assembly, characterization, and physics-guided data analysis
**Skills:** Ray Optics Simulation, Image Processing, Algorithm Development, Python
We are currently studying hyperspectral imaging with coded aperture.

projects.title: SPAD for Low-light spectroscopy
summary: **Goal:** Replace cooled CCD based spectroscopy
**Key Results:** 35% PDP with a 20cps/㎛² DCR, 1㎲ scale acquisition, Temperature coefficients of 10mV/K
**My Role**: Characterization, physics-guided data analysis, comparing with cooled CCD
**Skills:** Physics understanding, Algorithm Development, Python
We are currently comparing performances with cooled CCD

projects.title: SWIR Image Sensors based on Quantum Dot
summary: **Goal:** Developing monolithic image sensors using the PbS QDs(quantum dots) for SWIR(Short-Wavelength InfraRed).
**Key Results:** 10% EQE with a 200nA/cm² dark current density.
**My Role:** Device architecture design, optoelectronic evaluation, property analysis to guide subsequent design stage
**Skills:** Monolithic Image Sensors, SWIR Sensor Modelling & Characterization, SWIR Imaging, Image Processing, Python
We are currently preparing to commercialize this image sensor.

projects.title: Direct X-Ray Detectors based on Quantum Dot
summary: **Goal:** Developing monolithic image sensors using the PbS QDs(quantum dots) for X-Ray mammographic detectors
**Key Results:** 40µC/(Gy·cm²) sensitivity with 5nA/cm² dark current density.
**My Role:** Device architecture design, optoelectronic evaluation, property analysis to guide subsequent design stages.
**Skills:** Monolithic Image Sensors, X-Ray Sensor Modelling & Characterization, X-Ray Imaging, Image Processing, Python
We are currently investigating the QD size effect on X-Ray detection performance.

projects.title: Metasurface for High Spatial Resolution indirect X-Ray Detectors
summary: **Goal:** Addressing the fundamental limitation in spatial resolution of indirect X-Ray detectors caused by isotropic radiation within scintillators.
**Key Results:** Quadruple enhancement of MTF from 0.15 to 0.6.
**My Role:** Conceptualizing the Idea, Metasurface design, Optical simulation, and MTF Calculation
**Skills:** Physical Calculation, COMSOL Multiphysics(EM Wave), FDTD, Python
We currently investigates simplified metasurfaces via inverse design.

projects.title: Surface Enhanced Raman Scattering for Point of Care Testing
summary: **Goal:** Developing a Laser Scanning Raman spectroscope to quantitatively measure SERS from Au nanoparticles in fluid.
**Key Results:** SERS intensity coefficients of variation from 40% to 15%.
**My Role:** Understanding Physics, Designing and Developing Optical Instruments, Data Analysis
**Skills:** Solving Maxwell Equation, Ray Optics Simulation, Optical Set-up, Python

projects.title: Graphene based Optoelectronic Device
summary: **Goal:** Empirically demonstrating photodoping effect in a graphene-perovskite heterostructure.
**Key Results:** photodoping level of approximately 3×10¹²/cm² at zero gate bias (Fermi energy variation from 0.37 to 0.43eV).
**My Role:** Device design, Fabrication, Optoelectronic Evaluation, Property Analysis
**Skills:** Device Design, Fabrication, Evaluation, Analysis, Labview
